title: v3 conformance adapter Input
description: The stdin JSON an adapter reads. Document stages take a v3 document, the verifier nonce, the pinned repo, and the synthetic trust anchors it was produced under; v3-authenticate-approval takes a key-signed approval bundle with its pinned keys and artifact digest; v3-verify-timestamp takes an RFC 3161 response with the bytes it covers and the appraisal clock. Which members a stage requires is stated in fixture.schema.json. Empty/absent anchor fields select the embedded production roots.

sigstore_trusted_root_json_b64.description: base64 Sigstore trusted-root JSON: the certificate authorities and transparency logs for bundle verification, the transparency logs for v3-authenticate-approval checkpoints, the timestamp authorities for v3-verify-timestamp

verification_time_unix.description: pins the verification clock (seconds since the epoch): CRL and certificate validity windows at the quote layer and the freshness appraisal time, so a frozen real document replays at its capture time; absent/0 verifies at the current time. Sigstore bundle verification uses the bundle's own observer timestamps and is unaffected. For v3-verify-timestamp it is the appraisal clock and REQUIRED (nonzero): genTime must lie in [verification_time - 7 days, verification_time + 5 minutes].

bundle_json_b64.description: v3-authenticate-approval: base64 of the Sigstore bundle JSON (media type application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json) carrying the key-signed approval

signing_keys_pem.description: v3-authenticate-approval: the pinned approval signing keys, each a PEM "PUBLIC KEY" block (PKIX, ECDSA P-256); the bundle's hint must name one of them

artifact_digest_hex.description: v3-authenticate-approval: SHA-256 of the approved artifact, 64 lowercase hex; some subject of the signed statement must carry it as its sha256 digest

timestamp_response_b64.description: v3-verify-timestamp: base64 DER TimeStampResp under test

timestamp_input_b64.description: v3-verify-timestamp: base64 of the bytes the message imprint covers (the TSTInfo messageImprint must be their SHA-256)
